subject: Contingency credit request for 72h peak POC run
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@flowai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contingency credits for 72h peak POC run

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our engineering team is ready to run the full 72-hour peak soak next week to validate tail-latency and throughput under production-like traffic. We want to simulate sustained 1k RPS for 2 hours windows across 72 hours (burst-y pattern) and confirm latency p95 < 150ms for our assistant pipeline.

Before we start, procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a short-term contingency credit or promotional top-up to cover the expected token spend for the run. We estimate ~5M tokens during the test (roughly $4k at the trial TOS). The POC is on the critical path for our 2028 roadmap and we need to avoid the run aborting due to quota.

Can you advise on expedited credit provisioning and any paperwork needed? Happy to share the load profile and the preflight plan (attached).

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Engineering | FlowAI
alex@flowai.com

Attachment: poc_stress_plan.pdf (1.2MB, PDF)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@flowai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contingency credits for 72h peak POC run

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the detail and the attached plan. Short answer: yes, we can provision a short-term contingency credit to cover the POC run, conditional on a brief operational agreement (standard promotional credit terms). I want to loop in Karthik (SE) and Sean (Sales Engineering) to confirm the technical feasibility and an appropriate credit amount.

Karthik/Sean — can you review the attached plan and confirm the expected token/time profile? If the 5M estimate is accurate, I propose provisioning a $5k credit bucket that expires 30 days after issuance. Also copying Finance for quick signoff — tagging Michael for approval below.

Alex — once we have the technical thumbs-up, I’ll route a short credit agreement (DocuSign) and mark the credits as active. How soon do you need the credits to be live?

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700

On Thu, Sep 2, 2027 at 11:07 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik/Sean — can you review the attached plan and confirm the expected token/time profile?

Reviewed the plan and load profile looks realistic. A couple of technical notes for the run:
- We should pin to the optimized generation variant (quantized) to keep p95 latency in check under the simulated RPS.
- Recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for repeated prompt prefixes in the test; it drops token generation cost ~18% for this workload.
- If FlowAI can accept a brief <5% quality delta, we can provide guidance to lower sampling temperature to reduce tail variance during spikes.

Token estimate: 5M tokens is in the right ballpark. If we approve $5k in credits we should be covered for the described profile with a 10–15% safety buffer.

If Ops needs the credits live before Monday, we’ll need finance to sign-off today (Fri) and I can lock the runtime config for the run.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
